title: Zesty Middle Eastern Sloeberry Maqluba
description: A zesty, gluten-free maqluba that layers fragrant rice with tart sloeberries, chickpeas, and a spice-rich sauce, flipped and served upside-down for a dramatic presentation. The bright sumac and lemon juice give it a refreshing finish.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup rice until water runs clear, then soak for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, bring 1 cup vegetable broth to a boil, add soaked rice, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until rice is tender.
While rice cooks, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté 1 chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves until translucent.
Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp sumac, and a pinch of cinnamon, cooking for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Stir in 1 cup cooked chickpeas, 200 g sloeberries, and 1 cup tomato puree, cooking for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Season the mixture with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, and the juice of one lemon.
Assembly: in a 9x13-inch baking dish, layer the cooked rice at the bottom, then spread the chickpea and sloeberry mixture over the rice.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.
Remove foil, bake an additional 10 minutes until the top is slightly browned.
Let the maqluba rest for 5 minutes, then carefully flip onto a large platter to reveal the upside-down layers.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a sprinkle of sumac.
